content:
Profiles can be used to apply a specific version to your linked agents or scanners. This can be helpful
for testing; for example, you may want to schedule a testing period on a subset of your agents or
scanners before upgrading all your agents or scanners to a new version. A profile enables you to
apply a newer version to a subset of your agents or scanners for a limited time, and more broadly,
allows you to upgrade and downgrade agents or scanners to different versions easily. For more
information, see Agent Profiles and Scanner Profiles in the Tenable Vulnerability Management User
Guide.
